basic_details.job_title: UoH Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate I Posts
basic_details.post_name: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate - I
basic_details.short_information: University of Hyderabad (UoH), Telangana, has invited applications for 2 posts of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate - I under Advt No. UH/CEOAS-SoP/CHESS/JRF-02. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 17 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. (Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences/ Meteorology/ Physical Oceanography) or M.Tech. (Atmospheric/Oceanic Sciences)
qualification.details: Qualification: M.Sc. (Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences/ Meteorology/ Physical Oceanography); M.Tech. (Atmospheric/Oceanic Sciences) Age limit: Maximum 32 years | Other conditions: | Indian Nationals only | Desirable: | Thorough understanding of marine atmospheric boundary layer dynamics, atmospheric turbulence processes, meteorological and oceanic interactions over the North Indian Ocean Experience in atmospheric measurements, numerical modelling, and data analysis using satellite or in-situ observations Experience in handling and processing satellite and in-situ meteorological or oceanographic data Proficiency in computer programming using Python, MATLAB, Fortran, or C, and shell scripting Working knowledge of Linux/UNIX platforms Skill in data visualization and analysis using tools such as GrADS, NCL, Ferret, CDO, or similar scientific software

how_to_apply: Attach self-attested copies of all certificates in support of information.
Attach academic certificates, marks list and a brief CV.
Send the completed application by email to [email protected].
Clearly mention advertisement number in the subject of the email.
Email it on or before 17 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applications to be made are purely temporary Link for interview will be shared with short-listed candidates only

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. (Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences/ Meteorology/ Physical Oceanography); M.Tech. (Atmospheric/Oceanic Sciences) Age limit: Maximum 32 years Other conditions: Indian Nationals only Desirable: Thorough understanding of marine atmospheric boundary layer dynamics, atmospheric turbulence processes, meteorological and oceanic interactions over the North Indian Ocean Experience in atmospheric measurements, numerical modelling, and data analysis using satellite or in-situ observations Experience in handling and processing satellite and in-situ meteorological or oceanographic data Proficiency in computer programming using Python, MATLAB, Fortran, or C, and shell scripting Working knowledge of Linux/UNIX platforms Skill in data visualization and analysis using tools such as GrADS, NCL, Ferret, CDO, or similar scientific software

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration of the project: two (02) years Position offered initially for six months and can be extended based on progress and review every six months
